info.title: Ludworks API
info.summary: Self-hosted NAS multitool: files, virtual TV, notes, password vault, spreadsheets.
info.description:
Ludworks is a self-hosted, security-first NAS "multitool": files with resumable uploads, a retro virtual-TV
channel app, Markdown notes, an end-to-end-encrypted password vault, spreadsheets and admin tooling.
This document describes **HTTP API v1** (base path `/api/v1`). JSON is UTF-8 with `snake_case` fields;
IDs are opaque strings; timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC. Boolean query parameters are true for `1`, `true`, `yes` or `on`
(case-insensitive) and false otherwise. JSON request bodies must be sent as `application/json` (else 415) and are
capped at 1 MiB unless stated; unknown fields are ignored for forward compatibility.

## Authentication

| Method | How | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Browser session | `lw_session` cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`. **Unsafe requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) must send `X-CSRF-Token`** with the `csrf_token` returned by login / `GET /api/v1/auth/session`; a present `Origin` header must match the server. |
| Session token | `Authorization: Bearer lws_…` | From `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with `"token_mode": true` (SDK, apps, browser extension). Full access of the user, no CSRF. |
| Personal access token | `Authorization: Bearer lwp_…` | Created at `POST /api/v1/me/tokens`, limited to the chosen **scopes**, optional expiry. No CSRF. |
| Query token | `?access_token=<token>` | Only on streaming/feed endpoints (players, `<video>`, M3U/XMLTV). Prefer a PAT with only `media:read tv:read`; TV feed URLs use a token with only `tv:feed`. |

**Scopes:** `files:read files:write media:read media:write tv:read tv:write tv:feed notes:read notes:write vault:read
vault:write sheets:read sheets:write music:read music:write kanban:read kanban:write cast account admin` (`tv:feed`: only the TV feed and stream routes). Sessions have every scope (`*`); `admin` additionally
requires the admin role. Every operation states its requirement in `x-scope`: `public` (no auth), `auth`
(any signed-in principal), `admin`, or a scope name.

In this Swagger UI on the same origin your browser session cookie is sent automatically; for unsafe
requests authorise **csrfHeader** with the `csrf_token` from `GET /api/v1/auth/session`, or authorise
**bearerAuth** with a token instead.

## Errors

Errors use the HTTP status plus `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}`. Codes: `bad_request` 400,
`unauthorized` / `invalid_credentials` / `totp_required` 401, `forbidden` / `registration_disabled` 403,
`not_found` 404 (also used for resources you may not see), `conflict` 409, `gone` 410, `payload_too_large` 413,
`unsupported_media_type` 415, `validation_failed` 422 (`details.fields`), `rate_limited` 429 (`Retry-After`),
`internal` 500, `not_implemented` / `ffmpeg_unavailable` 501, `setup_required` 503 (before first-run setup),
`quota_exceeded` / `insufficient_storage` 507.

## Pagination

List endpoints that page take `limit` (default 50, max 200) and `cursor` and return
`{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "<opaque>" | null}`. Pass `next_cursor` back unchanged until it is `null`.

## Rate limits

Login, TOTP, password reset and setup are limited per IP and per account with exponential lockout
(5 free failures, then 2^n seconds up to 15 minutes). Every principal/IP also has a generous general
limit (200 requests/s, burst 1000, per signed-in user; 30 requests/s, burst 120, per IP without
authentication; tus upload chunks and `Range` requests for file, media, music and program content and cast media streams are exempt). Exceeding a limit returns `429` with `Retry-After`.

tags.name: Server
tags.description: Health check and the API description itself (OpenAPI document and Swagger UI).

tags.name: Setup
tags.description: First-run claim of a fresh server using the one-time setup token printed on first start.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login (cookie or bearer-token mode), logout, session info, self-registration, email verification and password reset.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in user: profile, password, TOTP two-factor authentication, sessions and personal access tokens (PATs).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administration: users, server settings (general, security, SMTP, IMAP, files, media, TV), audit log, library spaces, the category taxonomy and database backups. Requires the `admin` role; tokens additionally need the `admin` scope.

tags.name: Mail
tags.description: Outgoing mail (SMTP) for verification and password-reset emails, and incoming mail (IMAP) that turns emails from users into notes ("mail-in"). Configured through the `smtp` and `imap` settings namespaces.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Spaces, browsing, search, categories/tags, folder operations, downloads with HTTP Range support, thumbnails, ZIP downloads, simple uploads and rescans.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Resumable uploads using the tus 1.0.0 protocol (extensions: creation, termination, checksum, expiration). Use these for anything large.

tags.name: Trash
tags.description: Trashed files: list, restore, delete permanently, empty. Trash is purged automatically after `files.trash_retention_days`.

tags.name: Backup
tags.description: Devices of the desktop backup utility: the folders each device keeps synced into Files, and sync run reports.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Media library on top of Files: metadata (titles, shows, seasons, episodes, genres), probing, posters, playback streams, ffmpeg transcoding, subtitles, watch progress and TMDB lookups.

tags.name: TV
tags.description: Retro "virtual TV": lineups (ordered program sources), channels that play a lineup on a deterministic schedule (optionally shuffled), now-playing and the program guide.

tags.name: TV Feeds
tags.description: Integrations for external players and media servers: M3U playlist, XMLTV guide, MPEG-TS live streams and HDHomeRun tuner emulation (Plex, Jellyfin, VLC, Kodi).

tags.name: Music
tags.description: Music library on top of Files: tracks from audio tags, albums, artists, cover art, lyrics, manual and smart playlists, favorites, ratings and plays, live audio transcodes and offline-download renditions.

tags.name: Notes
tags.description: iOS-Notes-style Markdown notes with folders, tags, pinning, full-text search, code snippets, attachments, sync and bulk Markdown import/export.

tags.name: Vault
tags.description: End-to-end-encrypted password vault. The server only stores ciphertext (`v1.<nonce>.<ciphertext>`) and KDF parameters; see the Vault cryptography documentation.

tags.name: Browser
tags.description: Ludworks Browser sync: end-to-end-encrypted bookmarks, history, open tabs and preferences. The server only stores sealed strings (`v1.<nonce>.<ciphertext>`, sealed with a key derived from the vault key), needs an initialised vault and uses the vault scopes; see the Browser sync documentation.

tags.name: Sheets
tags.description: Spreadsheets: workbooks, sheets, cells with formulas and styles, ranges, row/column operations, formula evaluation, and XLSX/XLS/CSV import/export.

tags.name: Kanban
tags.description: Kanban boards: members and roles, columns with WIP limits, cards with labels, assignees, priorities, dates, subtasks, comments and attachments, and an activity log. Boards are visible only to their members; poll a board cheaply with `If-None-Match`.

tags.name: Casting
tags.description: Cast to Chromecasts (Cast v2, Default Media Receiver) and AirPlay devices (audio to HomePods and speakers, video to Apple TVs). The server controls the devices itself, so every client casts the same way; devices fetch media through short-lived capability URLs. Off until an administrator sets `cast.enabled`.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Storage usage (per user, space, category and volume) and server information.

get.description:
Liveness probe for load balancers and monitoring. Cheap; does not touch the disk. Answers even before first-run setup.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Server-generated IDs are 26-character lowercase base32 strings.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision.

NextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `null` on the last page.

Page.description: Generic shape of every cursor-paginated response. Concrete page schemas (e.g. `UserPage`, `EntryPage`) narrow `items`.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. `not_found`, `validation_failed`, `rate_limited`. Some endpoints add their own codes (e.g. `smtp_failed`, `imap_failed`).

message.description: Human-readable message (safe to show to users; never contains secrets).

details.description: Optional structured details, e.g. `fields` for `validation_failed` or `current` for version conflicts.

ValidationError.description: 422 body: `details.fields` maps each invalid field to a message.

disabled.description: Disabled accounts cannot log in; their sessions are revoked.

email_verified.description: Whether the email address was verified (required for mail-in).

totp_enabled.description: Whether TOTP two-factor authentication is enabled.

mail_in_enabled.description: Whether emails from this user's verified address are turned into notes.

Space.description: A storage root. Every file lives in exactly one space.

kind.description: `home` = a user's private space (created on demand); `library` = shared space managed by admins.

usage_bytes.description: Bytes used by files in this space (excluding trash).

Entry.description: A file or directory in a space.

parent_id.description: Parent directory entry; `null` for the space root.

path.description: Space-relative path, `/`-separated, no leading slash; the space root is `""`.

name.description: File or folder name (≤ 255 bytes UTF-8).

category.description: Category slug from the taxonomy (`movie`, `tv`, `music`, `image`, `game`, `document`, `software`, `other`) or `""`.

tags.description: Free-form tags.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the content; `""` until computed (see `files.compute_sha256`).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` value from the previous page.

IfRange.name: If-Range
IfRange.description: Only honour `Range` if the entity still matches this ETag or date.

SetSessionCookie.description: `lw_session=<token>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict` plus `Secure` when served over TLS (or behind a trusted TLS proxy).

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the content.

LastModified.description: HTTP date of the last content change.

BadRequest.description: `bad_request`: malformed JSON, a missing body, trailing data after the JSON value, or an invalid query parameter or header.

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: no valid session/token (missing, expired or revoked). Login-style endpoints also return `invalid_credentials` or `totp_required`.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: authenticated but not allowed — missing scope or admin role, disabled account, or a cookie request without a valid `X-CSRF-Token` / matching `Origin`.

NotFound.description: `not_found`: the resource does not exist **or is not visible to the caller** (existence is never revealed).

Conflict.description: `conflict`: the request conflicts with the current state (name taken, stale version, already initialised, …).

error.message: a file with that name already exists

PayloadTooLarge.description: `payload_too_large`: the request body exceeds the limit of this endpoint.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: `unsupported_media_type`: wrong `Content-Type` (JSON endpoints require `application/json`) or an unsupported file format.

ValidationFailed.description: `validation_failed`: one or more fields are invalid; see `details.fields`.

RateLimited.description: `rate_limited`: too many requests. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

error.message: too many attempts, try again later

NotImplemented.description: `not_implemented` / `ffmpeg_unavailable`: an optional feature is not available on this server.

error.message: ffmpeg is not available on this server

ServiceUnavailable.description: `setup_required`: the server has not been set up yet; complete first-run setup.

InsufficientStorage.description: `quota_exceeded` (user quota reached) or `insufficient_storage` (not enough free disk space).

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token: a session token (`lws_…`) from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with `token_mode: true`, or a personal access token (`lwp_…`) from `POST /api/v1/me/tokens`. Exempt from CSRF checks.

cookieAuth.name: lw_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session cookie set by login/setup/registration (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`). Unsafe methods additionally require `csrfHeader`.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: CSRF token of the cookie session (`csrf_token` from login or `GET /api/v1/auth/session`). Required on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE with cookie auth; ignored for bearer auth and safe methods.

accessTokenQuery.name: access_token
accessTokenQuery.description: Token in the query string. Accepted only by streaming and feed endpoints (marked in their description). Use a narrowly scoped PAT: URLs end up in player logs and history.
